title: Foot strength (3 exercises)

exercises.name: Towel toe curl and extension (arch crunch)
exercises.cues: Press big toe, outside of foot and heel down; curl the towel in with your toes, hold 5 s, then spread toes and push it back out.

exercises.name: Forced-arch single-leg heel raise
exercises.cues: Press big toe down and raise one heel, then alternate; the block forces the arch to lift.

exercises.name: Foot-bridge split squat
exercises.equipment: 2 yoga blocks under front foot (heel and ball, arch unsupported)
exercises.cues: Split squat with the front foot bridged; keep the front knee tracking over the toes.
exercises.caution: Knock-knees: don't let the knee cave in. Hold onto something at first.

notes: Low hernia risk (no heavy load or bracing). Good fit for foot and ankle rehab, but check with Ft. Sixto Curipoma. The app shows a 4th exercise not in the video: towel toe spacer with adduction and abduction, 3 x 10 s hold per side.

title: Legs up the wall (30-day lower-back relief)
notes: Passive restorative pose to offload lower back after sitting. Get in by sitting sideways against the wall and rolling onto the back while swinging legs up; avoid lifting both straight legs (core strain, hernia). Safe for knock-knees (no knee load).

exercises.name: Legs up the wall
exercises.reps: hold: week 1 3 min, week 2 5 min, weeks 3-4 10 min
exercises.cues: Flat on back, legs straight up the wall at ~90°; bend knees slightly if hamstrings are tight. Week 4: add slow deep belly breaths.
exercises.caution: Roll in from the side; don't do a double straight-leg raise. Don't force belly breaths hard.

title: Sciatica relief (3 moves, Back Pain Academy)
notes: Don't stretch sciatica with toe-touches; calm the nerve instead. Retest with a gentle straight-leg raise after. No sets/reps given. Hernia: prone work puts pressure on the belly and press-ups stretch the abdominal wall; go gently, stop on hernia discomfort, exhale on effort. Knees: no inward load.

exercises.name: Press-ups (sphinx to cobra)
exercises.cues: Lie face down, rest on elbows first, then push chest up and down; work up to full arm extension with hips on floor
exercises.caution: Prone + abdominal stretch: stay on elbows (sphinx) if the hernia feels pulled

exercises.name: Sciatic nerve floss
exercises.cues: On back, hip and knee at 90, hold behind thigh, straighten knee to the point of tension then bend; increase range gradually
exercises.caution: Hold the thigh with your hands so the abs don't have to work

exercises.name: Prone hip extension
exercises.cues: Face down, legs straight, lift the affected leg as high as comfortable and lower
exercises.caution: Lying on the belly; small range, no breath-holding

title: Back mobility when you're afraid to move (Ground app, 3 moves)
notes: 20 reps per exercise. No narration. Opens with an unnumbered wide-stance hinge into deep sumo squat. CAUTION for Sebas: shinbox loads knees inward (genu valgo) and scorpion stretches/twists the abdominal wall (hernia); floor roll sit-up spikes abdominal pressure. Use modified versions or skip.

exercises.name: Floor roll to forward fold
exercises.cues: Roll side to side across the back, sit up into a 90/90-like position, fold forward over the front knee
exercises.caution: Rolling sit-up raises abdominal pressure; push up with your hands instead of crunching up

exercises.name: Shinbox (90/90 switches)
exercises.cues: Sit, knees bent, drop both knees side to side pivoting on heels, twist torso with hands behind
exercises.caution: High risk for knock-knees: back leg in internal rotation pushes knee inward; keep feet wide, small range, or skip

exercises.name: Scorpion
exercises.cues: Face down, hands by chest, swing bent leg across body toward opposite side
exercises.caution: High risk for hernia (abdominal stretch + twist); swap for a lying-on-back knee-drop twist

title: Ankle & Achilles strength (7 moves)
notes: No sets/reps given in reel. Good for padel ankle prep. Moves 1-3 are low risk; keep knee over middle toes on 3-6; 6 do without weight first (hernia); 7 box jumps are high risk for hernia + knee valgus, save for later.

exercises.name: Seated banded plantar flexion
exercises.cues: Point toes against band, slow return
exercises.caution: Low risk

exercises.name: Seated banded ankle eversion
exercises.cues: Push foot outward, keep knee and thigh still
exercises.caution: Low risk

exercises.name: Seated banded toe-outs (both feet)
exercises.cues: Heels planted, pivot toes outward
exercises.caution: Keep knees still, don't let them cave in

exercises.name: Single-leg slant board calf raise
exercises.cues: Push through big toe, full range
exercises.caution: Knee tracks over middle toes

exercises.name: Single-leg deficit calf raise
exercises.cues: Heel drops below step, rise to tiptoe
exercises.caution: Watch knee caving at the bottom

exercises.name: Single-leg balance with kettlebell pass
exercises.cues: Slight knee bend, pass bell hand to hand
exercises.caution: Hernia: start without weight; push knee slightly out

exercises.name: Box jumps
exercises.cues: Land softly in partial squat
exercises.caution: High risk for hernia and knee valgus; skip for now

title: Lower-back extension with half-frog leg (@yoga_with_gokul)
notes: 6-8 slow reps per side, steady breathing. CAUTION: deep prone press-up stretches the abdominal wall (hernia). Safer swaps: shallow cat-cow for spine, upright kneeling hip-flexor stretch with glute squeeze.

exercises.name: Prone cobra with half-frog leg
exercises.cues: Lie face down, hands by ribs; slide one knee out to the side bent ~90; press up lifting chest with hips low; lower slowly
exercises.caution: Hernia: deep back arch stretches abs; keep it a small sphinx-height lift or swap. Don't force the bent knee flat

exercises.name: Swap: shallow cat-cow
exercises.cues: On all fours, round and gently arch
exercises.caution: Keep the arch shallow

exercises.name: Swap: kneeling hip-flexor stretch
exercises.cues: Half-kneel, torso upright, squeeze back glute, shift slightly forward
exercises.caution: Don't arch the lower back

title: Glute activation after sitting (wall single-leg bridge, @anatomy.of.motion)
notes: Sitting tightens hip flexors and limits hip extension so glutes don't engage. Reel gives no sets/reps.

exercises.name: Wall-supported single-leg glute bridge (incremental)
exercises.cues: On your back, feet on the wall hip-width apart, shins parallel to the floor. Pull the other knee to your chest, stopping before you feel a pinch at the front of the hip. Push into the wall and exhale to lift the hips a little, inhale, then on the next exhale lift a little higher. Stop before the low back takes over or arches. Lower, reset. Keep the toes relaxed.
exercises.caution: Hernia: low risk; exhale as you push and don't bear down or hold your breath with the knee pulled in. Knock-knees: moderate; the reel's cue to press through the inside heel and big toe can make the knee cave in, so press evenly through the whole foot and keep the knee pointing straight in line with hip and toes.

title: Core routine for back pain (physio, 5 moves)
notes: No voiceover; parameters from on-screen text. Safer versions are suggestions, not from the reel.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cues: On your back, knees bent, push hips to ceiling.
exercises.caution: Moderate: 30 reps invites straining; try 10-15. Band above knees and push out so knees don't cave.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cues: Back flat, knees 90°, arms up; lower opposite arm and leg.
exercises.caution: High hernia risk with straight legs; keep knees bent and do toe taps, or move only arms. Breathe.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.cues: Hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding.
exercises.caution: Moderate: keep it a small, gentle range; no deep arch or hard crunch.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cues: Hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg.
exercises.caution: Moderate: high volume; try 8-10 per side; slide one limb at a time if it strains.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cues: On elbow and feet, or on bottom knee (modified).
exercises.caution: High hernia risk with 1-min holds; do 4-6 holds of 10 s, breathe normally, knee version with padding.

title: Kettlebell fat-burning circuit (@deee.fit, 5 moves)
notes: 3 rounds, 30 s work / 30 s rest per move (~15 min). HIGH RISK overall for hernia and knock-knees: explosive, swung, overhead and rotational loads. Not recommended until cleared; use safer swaps.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge gorilla swing
exercises.cues: Step back into a lunge while swinging the bell between the legs; stand and swing it to chest height.
exercises.caution: High: swung load needs hard bracing; front knee likely to cave. Swap: bodyweight split squat holding a wall, knee over toes.

exercises.name: Squat pullover
exercises.cues: Bell held overhead by the horns; deep squat lowering it behind the head, press back up as you stand.
exercises.caution: High: overhead load in a deep squat. Swap: seated overhead triceps extension, light; or shallow wall sit.

exercises.name: Front raise curl
exercises.cues: Tall kneeling, press bell out from chest, back in, then curl down to waist.
exercises.caution: Moderate-high for hernia (long lever); knees low risk. Swap: seated curls with back support.

exercises.name: Lunge halo
exercises.cues: Reverse lunge while circling the bell around the head, alternating sides.
exercises.caution: High: overhead and rotational with unstable base. Swap: light seated halo.

exercises.name: Over shoulder toss
exercises.cues: Explosively drive the bell over one shoulder and back, alternating (not released).
exercises.caution: Very high: explosive rotation. Skip. Swap: light seated shoulder press.

title: Big toe strength & ankle stability: banded isometric heel raise
notes: Coach Milad and Ryan. Aims to stop the foot collapsing inward and knees caving. Ends with an app pitch. Hernia: breathe steadily through holds. Knock-knees: start with no band, then a very light one, use a mirror; skip the split squat progression until flawless.

exercises.name: Banded isometric heel raise
exercises.equipment: band anchored low, looped under the ankle bones, pulling the ankle inward
cues: Step away so the band pulls the ankle inward
Lift heel toward the ceiling
Press the big toe into the ground
Feel the burn in the outer ankle/calf (supinators)
exercises.caution: Moderate for knock-knees: a heavy band pulls the ankle and knee inward. Start with no band, then the lightest band, watch the knee in a mirror. Hold a wall for balance, breathe steadily, no breath holding.

exercises.name: Floating split squat with banded heel raise (progression)
cues: Keep the front heel lifted and big toe pressed while doing split squats
exercises.caution: High for knock-knees and hernia (bracing under load). Skip for now.

title: Bodybuilder vs functional: kettlebell swaps for row, press, lunge
notes: Pav Mann. 17s comparison clip, no sets/reps given (duration is an estimate at 3x10). Shows three kettlebell swaps for classic dumbbell moves. Hernia: Gorilla Row and Clean & Press need hard bracing, so start light with steady breathing and no breath holding. Knock-knees: lunges need the knee tracking over the 2nd-3rd toe; the Lunge Catch adds rotation, so master the plain reverse lunge first.

exercises.name: Gorilla row (alternating KB row from floor)
cues: Hinge with a flat back
Row one bell while the other stays planted
exercises.caution: Moderate for hernia: braced hinge; go light and breathe out on each pull.

exercises.name: KB clean & press (single arm)
cues: Clean to rack, then press overhead
exercises.caution: Moderate for hernia: explosive clean and overhead load. Start very light and exhale on the press.

exercises.name: Alternating reverse lunge with KB pass under front leg
cues: Step back, pass the bell under the front thigh to the other hand
exercises.caution: Moderate-high for knock-knees: watch that the front knee doesn't cave in. Master bodyweight reverse lunges first.

title: Lower back mobility routine (T-spine, window wipers, scorpion, cat cow)
notes: Mathew Wright. 5 rounds of 30s each for 4 moves (about 10 min). Bodyweight only, no spoken cues. Hernia: all four involve twisting or abdominal flexion. Go slow and pain-free, breathe out through the twist, and skip any move that pushes out on the hernia. Knock-knees: no knee load, so it's fine.

exercises.name: Seated T-spine rotation
cues: Sit leaning back on your hands, knees bent
Reach one hand across to the opposite knee, alternate
exercises.caution: Moderate for hernia: the lean-back brace plus twist. Sit more upright to reduce load.

exercises.name: Window wipers (bent knees)
cues: Lie on your back, arms in a T, knees at 90°
Lower your knees side to side under control
exercises.caution: Moderate-high for hernia: obliques control the legs. Keep your feet on the floor (supine knee drops) to start.

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
cues: Lie face down, arms in a T
Bring one foot across toward the opposite side
exercises.caution: Moderate: deep lumbar and pelvic twist. Go only to a gentle range.

exercises.name: Cat cow
cues: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching
exercises.caution: Low-moderate: gentle, breathe through it.

title: Kneeling quad raise to toe-squat (hip flexor / anterior pelvic tilt fix)
notes: @pontes_misericordiae on Threads, 6s loop, no sets or reps given. Overlay claims it fixes anterior pelvic tilt. Hernia: moderate, because the core braces as a bridge while leaning back. Knock-knees and feet: high risk, with deep knee flexion on the toes (valgus collapse) and extreme load on the ankles and plantar fascia. Not recommended for now; a half-kneeling hip flexor stretch is a safer substitute.

exercises.name: Kneeling quad raise to toe squat
cues: Kneel with shins and tops of feet flat, lean back on your hands
Lift knees off the mat onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly
exercises.caution: High for knees, feet and ankles. Moderate for hernia. Swap in a half-kneeling hip flexor stretch with a glute squeeze.

title: Lower back pain fix: hips, back strength, core (12 moves)
notes: Fraser Briggs (Movement Skool / Modern Body Fix). 3 blocks of 4 moves (hips, erectors, core). No sets or reps given. Mostly low risk. Hernia: the bench back extension, dumbbell side bend and V-up are moderate, so swap the V-up for a dead bug. Knock-knees: watch the knee on the single-leg airplane.

exercises.name: Supported single-leg airplane
cues: Back foot on a roller on the box, hinge forward
Rotate your torso over the standing hip
exercises.caution: Knock-knees: keep the standing knee over your toes and don't let it cave in. Hold onto something at first.

exercises.name: Quadruped hip extension (donkey kick)
cues: On hands and knees, kick one leg back and squeeze the glute
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Seated straddle leg lifts over a roller
cues: Sit with legs wide and hands behind you
Lift your straight legs over the roller and back
exercises.caution: Breathe out as you lift.

exercises.name: Couch stretch / half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
cues: Back knee down, top of the foot against the wall
Push your hips forward and squeeze the glute
exercises.caution: Pad the knee. Ease the foot position if your ankle complains.

exercises.name: Reverse hyperextension
cues: Lie face down with hips at the edge of the bench
Lift your straight legs to parallel
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Prone Y raise / superman
cues: Lie face down, arms in a Y
Lift your chest, arms and legs, then hold briefly
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Bench back extension
cues: Thighs on the bench, feet anchored
Lower your torso, then lift to neutral
exercises.caution: Hernia: go slow and don't arch too far.

exercises.name: Seated good morning
cues: Sit with your back straight and hands behind your head
Hinge forward and come back up
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling dumbbell side bend
cues: Half-kneeling, bend sideways with the dumbbell
exercises.caution: Hernia: go light and breathe out. Don't hold your breath.

exercises.name: Alternating V-up
cues: On your back, crunch and touch your opposite hand to your foot
exercises.caution: Hernia: the most aggressive one here. Swap in a dead bug.

exercises.name: Spiderman plank
cues: From a high plank, bring your knee to the outside of your elbow
exercises.caution: Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling Pallof press with rotation
cues: Half-kneeling, press the band forward and rotate a little
exercises.caution: Good choice for hernia-safe core work.

title: Banded glute workout on yoga blocks (4 moves)
notes: Artem Davidchenko, promoting an 8-week band program. No sets or reps given. Hernia: low. Knock-knees: moderate, because the band pulls the knees in, so push them out. Feet: the soft blocks add instability, so start on a flat floor.

exercises.name: Banded lateral step-down from blocks
exercises.equipment: 2 yoga blocks, mini band below the knees
cues: One foot on each block, half squat
Step one foot out and down to the floor, deeper squat, return
exercises.caution: Push your knees out against the band. Do it on the floor before using the blocks.

exercises.name: Banded elevated squat on blocks
exercises.equipment: 2 yoga blocks, mini band below the knees
cues: One foot on each block, shoulder width
Squat with your chest up and hips back
exercises.caution: Push your knees out against the band. Do it on the floor first.

exercises.name: Banded front-foot-elevated split squat (each side)
exercises.equipment: 2 yoga blocks, mini band below the knees
cues: Front foot on the block, back foot on the ball of the foot
Lower your back knee toward the floor
exercises.caution: High foot and ankle load on a soft block. Start on the floor and add the block later. Keep your front knee over your toes.

title: Active mobility for a stiff lower back (4 floor moves)
notes: Borja Sanfelix. 5-10 min, pain-free, quality over intensity. No sets or reps given. All floor work. Hernia: low. Knock-knees: only the knee-drop bridge is moderate.

exercises.name: Active supine butterfly
cues: On your back, soles together, hold your ankles
Actively press your knees toward the floor
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Glute bridge with knee drop (internal rotation)
cues: Feet wide, bridge up
Drop your knees in on the way down, drive them out on the way up
exercises.caution: Knock-knees: this practices the valgus position, so go gentle and small, or skip it.

exercises.name: Ankle-grab glute bridge
cues: Feet close to your glutes, hold your ankles
Drive your hips up and hold
exercises.caution: Safe. Ease off if the front of your ankle bothers you.

exercises.name: Isometric single-leg glute bridge
cues: One foot planted, the other leg straight up
Hold the bridge with your hips level
exercises.caution: Keep the planted knee in line with the foot.

title: 4 stretches for stiff hips and lower back
notes: Banimb Mbappe. Passive stretches, no holds given. Happy baby is safe. Pigeon and 90/90 are moderate for the knees. Frog is high for genu valgo, so skip it. 90/90 has a gentle twist, which matters for the hernia.

exercises.name: Happy baby
cues: On your back, knees wide toward your armpits
Hold the outer edges of your feet and pull gently down
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Pigeon (paloma)
cues: Front shin bent across, back leg straight
Lean forward onto your forearms
exercises.caution: Knee torque. Use a pillow under your hip, or do a figure-4 stretch on your back instead.

exercises.name: 90/90 twist
cues: Sit in 90/90
Twist your torso away from the back leg, with one hand for support
exercises.caution: Hernia: twist gently and breathe out. Knees: go easy on the back knee.

exercises.name: Frog (rana)
cues: On your forearms, knees very wide at 90 degrees
Push your hips back
exercises.caution: Skip it with genu valgo. There's direct stress on the inner knee. A wide-knee child's pose is gentler.

title: Forward head posture: kneeling T-spine rotation + neck flexion stretch
notes: The Sculptor (Posture Sculpting, #10WEEKS). One flow, about a 10s neck hold, no sets or reps. Low risk for both hernia and knees. Pull your head gently, never hard.

exercises.name: Kneeling thoracic rotation to neck flexion stretch
cues: Kneel leaning forward, hand behind your head, rotate your elbow to the ceiling
Forearms down, hands clasped behind your head, tuck your chin and pull gently
exercises.caution: Gentle pull on the neck. Stop if you feel tingling.

title: Anterior pelvic tilt protocol in 4 phases (Juan Mota)
notes: Juan Mota. Test: if your whole hand fits behind your lower back against the wall, you have anterior pelvic tilt. Don't stretch the psoas hard. All 4 phases are low risk for hernia and knees. The dead bug is the hernia-safe swap for V-ups.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling posterior tilt (reciprocal inhibition)
cues: Half-kneeling, tuck your pelvis, squeeze the glute and abs
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Isometric dead bug
exercises.reps: 8 per side, 3s hold at the bottom
cues: Arms up, knees at 90 degrees, lower back pressed into the floor
Lower one leg to hover, hold 3s, return
exercises.caution: Breathe out as you lower the leg. If your back lifts off the floor, shorten the range.

exercises.name: Glute bridge squeezing a cushion
cues: Cushion between your knees, push through your heels
Don't arch your back at the top
exercises.caution: The cushion helps keep your knees aligned. Good for genu valgo.

exercises.name: Hip hinge with rib-to-pelvis check
cues: Thumb on your lowest rib, index finger on your pelvis
Push your hips back without that distance changing
exercises.caution: Safe.

title: 5 kneeling bodyweight core moves, 50 reps a day each
notes: Adrián López. The clickbait claims ('belly will disappear', 'erase back pain') are spot-reduction myths, so treat it as light core and glute activation. Pad your knees. Hernia: the twisting reach-backs (heel and floor touches) are moderate, so do them slowly and breathe out.

exercises.name: Kneeling hip thrust
cues: Kneel tall, hands behind your head
Sit your hips back toward your heels, then drive them forward
exercises.caution: Squeeze your glutes, don't arch your lower back.

exercises.name: Kneeling alternate heel touch
cues: Kneel tall, twist and reach back to the same-side heel
exercises.caution: Twist plus back-bend. Go slow and breathe out.

exercises.name: Kneeling alternate floor punch (side bend)
cues: Side-bend to touch the floor beside your knee
exercises.caution: Controlled pace.

exercises.name: Kneeling lateral crunch
cues: Hands behind your head, side-bend left and right
exercises.caution: Safe.

exercises.name: Kneeling twist to touch floor behind feet
cues: Twist and reach the floor behind your feet, alternating
exercises.caution: Twisting reach. Go slow and breathe out, and skip it if your hernia pushes out.
